scope: Hash-bound bit walk of eight table-control and resource bodies in one ODA-created AC1018 TABLESTYLE graph. This is selected source-wire evidence, not a general codec, semantic interoperability, full dependency-closure or output qualification.

authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 SHA256 1ed2e02722862188120da606e4b6a816fa4014c96de68da2f84a2ecda09461e7, sections 20.4.55 through 20.4.58 and 28. The spec identifies STYLE/SHAPEFILE and LTYPE records and controls, soft ordinary and hard phantom control-member roles, and EED application handle/string/value schema. Section 20.4.57 names the phantom order ByLayer then ByBlock, whereas the pinned physical source and LibreDWG read it as ByBlock then ByLayer; the latter ordering is an observed source profile, not a general ODA order. Font file names and EED bytes do not establish font rendering, glyph availability or cross-platform substitution semantics.

wire.style_control_0x3: BS type 52; 13-byte body, decoded offset 46 ordinal 2. Common no EED, zero reactors and xdict-missing=1; count BL1 [63,73). H4 null [73,81), H2 STYLE 0x11 [81,97), seven zero padding bits.
wire.style_0x11: BS type 53; 59-byte body, decoded offset 826 ordinal 14, data end bit 445. One 14-byte EED chunk: H5 APPID 0x12 [68,84), raw data 00 05 00 2d 41 72 69 61 6c 47 00 00 00 00 [84,196), zero EED terminator. Per ODA this is code 0 five-byte ASCII Arial with raw codepage bytes 00 2d, followed by code 71 int32 0; no inference of non-ASCII codepage behavior. Name Standard, source xref flag bits 1/0/0, vertical=0, shape=0, height=0, width=1, oblique=0, generation=0, last-height=2.5, font filename arial.ttf, bigfont empty. Tail H4 owner STYLE_CONTROL 0x3 [445,461), H5 null xref [461,469), three zero pad bits. Source field spans are executable in the verifier.
wire.ltype_control_0x5: BS type 56; 17-byte body, decoded offset 63 ordinal 3; count BL1 [63,73). H4 null [73,81), H2 Continuous 0x16 [81,97), H3 ByBlock 0x14 [97,113), H3 ByLayer 0x15 [113,129), seven zero padding bits. Count excludes the two phantom entries. Source handle order and ownership roles matter and are not interchangeable.

Names ByBlock, ByLayer, Continuous; xref flag bits 1/0/0; description empty, empty, Solid line; pattern length 0; alignment RC65; dash count 0; explicit 256-byte all-zero string area. Each tail H4 owner 0x5 and H5 null xref followed by seven zero pad bits. Decoded offsets/ordinals: 0x14 1186/16, 0x15 1469/17, 0x16 889/18.
wire.appid_control_0x9_and_appid_0x12: APPID_CONTROL type 66, length 17, decoded offset 131 ordinal 7, BL3 [63,73); H4 null, ordered H2 entries 0x12,0xcd,0xd7. APPID 0x12 type 67, length 18, offset 1948 ordinal 15, name ACAD, xref flag bits 1/0/0, unknown RC0, H4 owner 0x9, H5 null xref. Peer identifies 0xcd/0xd7 as APPID siblings, but their source bodies were not captured or qualified.

capture.checkout_and_instrument: mkdir -p /private/tmp/p5-resource-src; git archive e5341dd31d686c529ba2f8172de56868bc3551b9 | tar -x -C /private/tmp/p5-resource-src; python3 tools/research/p5_ac1018_table_resources_scratch_instrument.py --reader /private/tmp/p5-resource-src/src/intern/dwgreader.cpp. The script verifies the untouched archived file SHA256 before editing; never instrument the working checkout.
capture.instrumentation: Only scratch archived code is modified, immediately after successful DwgObjectFrame::readAt in parseControl/parseTableRecord; readAt performs object frame CRC16 checking. Eight body files are written to /private/tmp, with selected source offsets and ordinals logged. Script output was byte-for-byte compared with the scratch source used for the observed build. The verifier below does not itself validate the frame CRC or authenticate arbitrary body-to-source association.

Self-test changes the STYLE EED APPID H role and confirms rejection by the field walker rather than relying on a digest mismatch.
implementation_next_and_open: Smallest bounded standalone next slice: verify LTYPE_CONTROL and ByBlock together with their exact count, full string area, ordered H roles and selected typed fields, using scratch-generated controls for ownership/order/role/count/truncation/reset/failure-retry; a separate reader-private source ticket and same-read join are required before claiming source association. Control 0x5 also references 0x15 and 0x16; this receipt walks their source bodies, but no output mapping or semantic readback is qualified. STYLE 0x11 points through EED to APPID 0x12; APPID_CONTROL references 0xcd and 0xd7 whose source bodies and closure remain open. STYLE_CONTROL, APPID, font behavior, TABLESTYLE extension subtree, whole graph, ordering-preserving destination emission, independent consumer semantics and Linux/Windows qualification are separate remaining work.
